answer: One anti-Sybil mechanism is concurrency-bounded liveness duels. Each epoch, identities are paired at random and must answer a fresh nonce within a short window, like one dedicated thread of attention each. The protocol deliberately over-books: every identity is summoned into overlapping duels at unpredictable times. A single operator then faces a knoll it cannot climb, because missing a duel burns that identity's voting power and leaves an inlet into its timing fingerprint. Attacker cost scales superlinearly in live attention; honest users spend minutes.
